title: Frontend developer
intro: Tools that turn designs into code, make it look good, and check it in a real browser.

picks.name: Figma Context MCP

install.label: Add to Claude Code
install.cmd: claude mcp add figma -- npx -y figma-developer-mcp --figma-api-key=YOUR-KEY --stdio

picks.why: Gives the agent the layout and styles of a Figma frame, so the code matches the design.

picks.name: frontend-design
picks.why: Anthropic's own skill for distinctive, production grade interfaces instead of generic layouts.

picks.name: Playwright MCP
picks.why: From Microsoft. The agent clicks through your app and checks what actually renders.

picks.name: Chrome DevTools MCP

install.label: Add to Claude Code
install.cmd: claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

picks.why: From the Chrome team. Network, console and performance traces, read by the agent.

picks.name: Claude Code
picks.why: Runs every tool above from one terminal.
